nativeTools.name: Redis native distribution

provenance.verification: Provisioner bounds Content-Length, verifies SHA-256 before extraction, validates every archive member path, discards ambient build selectors, and builds inside the repository cache. Only the two admitted binaries are built: the Redis 8 default goal routes through scripts/build.sh, which additionally builds every bundled module under modules/*/src and fails on RedisSearch because no Rust toolchain is provisioned. Install copies the two binaries rather than invoking the upstream install target, which depends on `all` and would also build the sentinel, benchmark and test modules. After install the provisioner asserts the provisioned tree contains exactly bin/redis-server and bin/redis-cli, refuses any .so, and probes both command versions.

nativeTools.removalBoundary: Remove cache/coordination use or replace behind the deny-safe coordination boundary; no replacement may authorize money.
